neighbours.label: the last word of the middle item in a three-item list, just before the closing 'and' ("A, B and C"); the output direction promotes sentence-final punctuation
fire: State regulators, consumer advocates and insurance executives testified at the hearing.
Rising sea levels, coastal erosion and stronger storms threaten the village.
Scout leaders, eager volunteers and parents gathered at the trailhead.
The report was praised by budget analysts, privacy advocates and union leaders.
Poor soil, drought and late frosts ruined the harvest that year.
Local farmers, school teachers and shop owners signed the petition.
The storm brought high winds, flooding and power cuts to the coast.
Retired nurses, medical students and paramedics staffed the clinic.
quiet: Consumer advocates testified at the hearing about insurance prices.
Coastal erosion threatens the village more each winter.
Eager volunteers gathered at the trailhead before dawn.
The report was praised by privacy advocates across the country.
A long drought ruined the harvest that year.
School teachers and shop owners signed the petition.
The storm brought flooding to the coast for a week.
Medical students staffed the clinic on weekends.

notes: Probes: three-item lists 0.45 and 0.25 on the middle item's last word; the same nouns outside a list 0.06 and 0.03; two-item 'Teachers and parents' 0.02. Top examples also include bibliography initials and first names before a period ('Kessler, Edward.', 'R. E.'), probed at 0.29-0.33, which this label leaves out. Readings are close to the 0.20 threshold, so the test may fail on strength.
